title: JobMessage
description: Message pushed to Redis (repodna:jobs) by the API when a job is created. Consumed by the analysis worker.

job_id.description: UUID of the job row in Postgres. Primary key used for all status/result callbacks. NOTE: 'format: uuid' is annotation-only in most validators (networknt, python jsonschema) unless format assertion is explicitly enabled -- turn that on, or add a regex 'pattern' here as a backup, or invalid UUIDs will pass silently.

source_type.description: Which of repo_url / zip_path is populated. Exactly one must be a non-null string; the other must be null -- enforced below.

repo_url.description: Public HTTPS GitHub/GitLab URL. Must be a real string when source_type is 'git', and must be null when source_type is 'zip'.

zip_path.description: Path on the shared volume where the uploaded ZIP was saved. Must be a real string when source_type is 'zip', and must be null when source_type is 'git'.
